title: BlockDrop minigames
description: Outrun the fall, outplay them all
body:
# 🎲 BlockDrop | The Professional TNT-Run Experience [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Spigot%20%7C%20Paper%20%7C%20Purpur-cyan)](https://modrinth.com) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.13%20--%201.26.1.2%2B-orange)](#) [![Geyser](https://img.shields.io/badge/Crossplay-GeyserMC%20Verified-green)](#) > **BlockDrop: Don’t stop, just drop!** > A highly optimized, feature-rich mini-game plugin for Minecraft servers. Experience smooth block fading, an anti-camp system, and unmatched performance. --- ## 🌟 What is BlockDrop? **BlockDrop** is a modern, professional reimagining of the classic TNT-Run mini-game. Instead of blocks vanishing instantly under a player's feet, they dynamically cycle through warning states (**Green ➔ Yellow ➔ Red ➔ Air**). This introduces an extra layer of strategy, giving players a visual countdown before they fall. Built from the ground up for high-performance networks, BlockDrop ensures your server maintains a stable 20 TPS, even with dozens of active arenas. --- ## ✨ Key Features * 🚀 **Smart-Batch Restoration Engine:** Unlike outdated plugins that clone entire regions (causing heavy lag spikes), BlockDrop tracks **only the exact blocks touched during the match** and restores them in small, throttled batches (500 blocks per tick) once the game ends. * 📱 **Flawless GeyserMC Cross-play:** Fully tested and verified for Bedrock edition players! Scoreboards, custom interactive GUIs, and inventory states sync perfectly across Java and Bedrock. * 🛑 **Advanced Anti-Camp System:** Players cannot cheat by standing still. The plugin actively tracks player coordinates every few ticks, dropping blocks even if a player refuses to move. * 🛡️ **Fail-Safe Inventory Backups:** Before entering an arena, players' inventories, armor, health, and hunger stats are securely backed up. Everything is perfectly restored when they leave or win, even if the server restarts mid-game. * 🛏️ **Seamless Staging & Quit GUI:** Players are automatically given a custom "Leave Game" bed in their 9th slot while in the lobby. Right-clicking opens an intuitive GUI to gracefully exit using `/bd leave`. * 🌍 **100% Configurable:** Customize every single message, title, scoreboard line, and countdown duration via `config.yml` and `messages.yml`. --- ## 🛠️ Setup Guide 1. Download the `BlockDrop.jar` and drop it into your server's `/plugins` folder. 2. Restart the server to generate configuration files. 3. Build your arena platform, stand at one corner, and type `/bd [ArenaName] pos1`. 4. Go to the opposite diagonal corner of the platform and type `/bd [ArenaName] pos2`. 5. Set up your game waypoints by standing on the desired locations and running: * `/bd [ArenaName] setlobby` (Staging area for waiting players) * `/bd [ArenaName] setspawn` (Where players spawn when the match starts) * `/bd [ArenaName] setreturn` (Where players are sent after the game ends) * `/bd [ArenaName] setspectator` (Where eliminated players go to watch) 6. Give your users the `bd.player` permission, and you're good to go! --- ## 📝 Commands & Permissions ### For Players (`bd.player` - Enabled by default) * `/bd join [arena]` — Teleport to the designated arena lobby. * `/bd leave` — Safely exit the current game and return to the fallback position. ### For Admins (`bd.admin` - Operator only) * `/bd help` — Display the administrative setup helper. * `/bd create [name]` — Register and create a new arena configuration. * `/bd [name] pos1` / `pos2` — Define the block-fading zone boundaries. * `/bd [name] setlobby` / `setspawn` / `setreturn` / `setspectator` — Set game world waypoints. * * Suppot * For assistance, register here https://gemini.google.com/gem/10YndAykjWwhBAfeOVsS33h6YGdtAmHn2?usp=sharing And then follow this link again after registration. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration Preview
